mapper.sql: CASE WHEN d.kind = THEN 1 ELSE -1 END

FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id
LEFT JOIN scm_customer p ON p.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN fin_material_cost mc ON mc.material_id = i.material_id AND mc.period = YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date)
LEFT JOIN scm_supplier p ON p.id = d.partner_id

SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = THEN i.qty ELSE 0 END) AS "bizQty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = THEN 0 ELSE i.qty END) AS "returnQty", SUM( * i.qty) AS "netQty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = THEN i.amount - i.tax_amount ELSE 0 END) AS "bizAmount", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = THEN 0 ELSE i.amount - i.tax_amount END) AS "returnAmount", SUM( * (i.amount - i.tax_amount)) AS "netAmount", SUM( * i.amount) AS "taxedAmount",
SUM( * i.qty * COALESCE(mc.unit_cost, m.ref_cost, 0)) AS "cost", SUM(CASE WHEN mc.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "missingCost",
0 AS "cost", 0 AS "missingCost",
COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS "docCount"
mapper.select:
SELECT AS "groupKey",
p.name u.nickname CONCAT(m.code, ' ', m.name) NULL AS "groupName",
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.salesman_id
GROUP BY
, p.name , u.nickname , m.code, m.name
ORDER BY 1 ORDER BY SUM( * (i.amount - i.tax_amount)) DESC, 1
LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql:
SELECT d.id AS "docId", d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.kind AS "kind", d.biz_date AS "bizDate", p.name AS "partnerName", u.nickname AS "salesmanName", w.name AS "warehouseName", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", m.spec AS "spec", m.unit AS "unit", m.category AS "category", m.brand AS "brand", * i.qty AS "qty", i.price AS "price", * (i.amount - i.tax_amount) AS "amount", * i.amount AS "taxedAmount",
* i.qty * COALESCE(mc.unit_cost, m.ref_cost, 0) AS "cost", CASE WHEN mc.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "costed",
i.remark AS "remark"
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.salesman_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id)
ORDER BY d.biz_date, d.id, i.id
mapper.select: SELECT YEAR(settle_date) * 100 + MONTH(settle_date) AS "period", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RECEIPT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "receipt", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'PAYMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "payment" FROM fin_settlement WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND settle_date >= #{begin} AND settle_date <= #{end} GROUP BY YEAR(settle_date) * 100 + MONTH(settle_date)

SELECT YEAR(advance_date) * 100 + MONTH(advance_date) AS "period", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RECEIPT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "receipt", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'PAYMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "payment" FROM fin_advance WHERE advance_date >= #{begin} AND advance_date <= #{end} GROUP BY YEAR(advance_date) * 100 + MONTH(advance_date)
mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT lc.unit_cost FROM fin_material_cost lc WHERE lc.material_id = m.id AND lc.unit_cost > 0 ORDER BY lc.period DESC LIMIT 1), m.ref_cost, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT x.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.name AS "warehouseName", x.category AS "category", SUM(x.qty) AS "qty", SUM(x.amount) AS "amount" FROM ( SELECT t.warehouse_id, m.category, t.qty, t.qty * AS amount FROM (SELECT s.warehouse_id, s.material_id, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock s GROUP BY s.warehouse_id, s.material_id) t JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id WHERE t.qty <> 0 ) x JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = x.warehouse_id WHERE w.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' GROUP BY x.warehouse_id, w.name, x.category

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND status <> 'SETTLED') AS "arBalance", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND status <> 'SETTLED' AND due_date < #{today}) AS "arOverdue", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AP' AND status <> 'SETTLED') AS "apBalance", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - used_amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = 'RECEIPT') AS "advanceReceived", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - used_amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = 'PAYMENT') AS "advancePaid"
mapper.sql: SELECT i.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * (i.amount - i.tax_amount)) AS amount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * i.qty * COALESCE(mc.unit_cost, sm.ref_cost, 0)) AS cost FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN wms_material sm ON sm.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN fin_material_cost mc ON mc.material_id = i.material_id AND mc.period = YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{q.begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{q.end} AND COALESCE(i.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) = #{q.warehouseId} GROUP BY i.material_id

SELECT s.material_id, SUM(s.qty) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN w.type IN ('DEFECT', 'CONSIGN_OUT') THEN 0 ELSE s.qty - s.frozen_qty END) AS available FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE w.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' AND s.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} GROUP BY s.material_id
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS code, m.name AS name, m.spec AS spec, m.unit AS unit, m.category AS category, m.brand AS brand, sl.qty AS sales_qty, sl.amount AS sales_amount, sl.cost AS cost, COALESCE(st.qty, 0) AS stock_qty FROM () sl JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = sl.material_id LEFT JOIN () st ON st.material_id = m.id WHERE sl.qty > 0
ORDER BY
sl.qty sl.amount - sl.cost sl.amount DESC, m.code

SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS code, m.name AS name, m.spec AS spec, m.unit AS unit, m.category AS category, m.brand AS brand, COALESCE(sl.qty, 0) AS sales_qty, COALESCE(sl.amount, 0) AS sales_amount, st.qty AS stock_qty, st.qty * AS stock_amount, ls.last_date AS last_sale_date FROM wms_material m JOIN () st ON st.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN () sl ON sl.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.material_id, MAX(d.biz_date) AS last_date FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' AND d.biz_date <= #{q.end} GROUP BY i.material_id) ls ON ls.material_id = m.id WHERE st.qty > 0 AND COALESCE(sl.qty, 0) <= #{q.slowQty}
) x ORDER BY x.stock_amount DESC, x.code

SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS code, m.name AS name, m.spec AS spec, m.unit AS unit, m.category AS category, m.brand AS brand, sl.qty AS sales_qty, sl.amount AS sales_amount, st.qty AS stock_qty, st.qty * AS stock_amount FROM wms_material m JOIN () st ON st.material_id = m.id JOIN () sl ON sl.material_id = m.id WHERE st.qty > 0 AND sl.qty > 0 AND st.qty * #{days} > sl.qty * #{q.overstockDays}
) x ORDER BY x.stock_qty / x.sales_qty DESC, x.code
mapper.sql: SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(oi.qty - oi.done_qty + oi.replenish_qty) AS qty FROM scm_order_item oi JOIN scm_order oo ON oo.id = oi.order_id WHERE oo.kind = '${orderKind}' AND oo.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND oi.qty - oi.done_qty + oi.replenish_qty > 0 GROUP BY oi.material_id
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS code, m.name AS name, m.spec AS spec, m.unit AS unit, m.category AS category, m.brand AS brand, m.safety_stock AS safety_stock, COALESCE(st.qty, 0) AS stock_qty, COALESCE(st.available, 0) AS available_qty, COALESCE(so.qty, 0) AS so_open, COALESCE(po.qty, 0) AS po_open FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN () st ON st.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN () so ON so.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN () po ON po.material_id = m.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND ((m.safety_stock > 0 AND COALESCE(st.available, 0) < m.safety_stock) OR COALESCE(st.available, 0) < COALESCE(so.qty, 0))
ORDER BY COALESCE(m.safety_stock, 0) + COALESCE(so.qty, 0) - COALESCE(st.available, 0) DESC, m.code
mapper.sql:
SELECT f.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(sd.biz_date, ck.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) < #{q.begin} THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS open_qty, SUM(f.qty) AS close_qty FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc sd ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND sd.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check ck ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND ck.id = f.doc_id WHERE COALESCE(sd.biz_date, ck.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) <= #{q.end} AND wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN'
AND f.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER'
GROUP BY f.material_id
mapper.select:
SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS code, m.name AS name, m.spec AS spec, m.unit AS unit, m.category AS category, m.brand AS brand, COALESCE(fl.open_qty, 0) AS open_qty, COALESCE(fl.close_qty, 0) AS close_qty, COALESCE(sl.qty, 0) AS sales_qty, COALESCE(sl.amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(sl.cost, 0) AS cost FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN () fl ON fl.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN () sl ON sl.material_id = m.id WHERE (fl.material_id IS NOT NULL OR sl.material_id IS NOT NULL)
) x WHERE x.open_qty <> 0 OR x.close_qty <> 0 OR x.sales_qty <> 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.open_qty + x.close_qty > 0 THEN x.sales_qty / (x.open_qty + x.close_qty) ELSE 999999999 END, x.code
